copy_policy: Independent editorial analysis; no reproduced NASA images, no NASA endorsement or permission claim.

claims.heading: A rehearsal still carried a fatal cabin hazard
claims.claim: The plugs-out ground test exposed the crew to hazards inside the command module even though the Saturn IB was not fueled.
claims.board_basis: Apollo 204 Review Board, account of the ground test and Board findings on test conditions and emergency egress.
claims.image_basis: The January 1967 portrait establishes the crew and period only.
claims.boundary: It does not show the cabin atmosphere, electrical condition, hatch status or test decisions.
claims.research_status: Board text checked; catalog caption matched; image reproduction not cleared.

claims.heading: The pressure and oxygen mixture were hazardous
claims.claim: The Board recorded a 16.7 psia, 100-percent oxygen atmosphere during the test and classified the conditions as extremely hazardous.
claims.board_basis: Apollo 204 Review Board, Part VI, Board Findings, Determinations and Recommendations, Finding 2.
claims.image_basis: NASA S67-15717 shows preparations on 3 January 1967, not atmospheric instrumentation.
claims.boundary: Oxygen supported the rapid fire; neither oxygen nor this photograph identifies the ignition source.
claims.research_status: Board finding and dated NASA catalog metadata checked; image reproduction not cleared.

claims.heading: The first radio report is not the ignition timestamp
claims.claim: The first crew transmission reporting the emergency began at approximately 23:31:04.7 GMT.
claims.board_basis: Apollo 204 Review Board, reconstruction of events from 23:20 GMT through the first fire report, and voice transmission analysis.
claims.image_basis: NASA S66-58038 is dated 18 October 1966 and documents an altitude-chamber training exercise.
claims.boundary: The report does not prove ignition started at 23:31:04.7; the training photograph is not telemetry or footage of the fire.
claims.research_status: Timestamp and 1966 image date checked independently; image reproduction not cleared.

claims.heading: The hatch was not an instant escape route
claims.claim: The pressure vessel ruptured at about 23:31:19 GMT, at an estimated pressure of at least 29 psia; emergency egress could not be completed before rupture.
claims.board_basis: Apollo 204 Review Board, cabin-pressure reconstruction and emergency hatch chronology.
claims.image_basis: NASA KSC-20170124-PH_KLS01_0164 depicts a tribute-era spacecraft mockup; its NASA caption also describes hatch exhibits.
claims.boundary: The museum-era photograph does not depict a 1967 rupture, a pressure trace or the accident hatch being operated during the test.
claims.research_status: Estimate and 2017 NASA caption checked; photograph bytes not reproduced.

claims.heading: The precise initiator remained unidentified
claims.claim: The Board judged an electrical arc the most probable initiating source but identified no single conclusive ignition point.
claims.board_basis: Apollo 204 Review Board, Part VI, Finding 1 and associated fire-origin analysis.
claims.image_basis: NASA S67-21294 depicts fire damage inside Command Module 012 on 28 January 1967.
claims.boundary: Damage is evidence of the fire and its effects, not a photograph of the original arc, its location or its exact start time.
claims.research_status: Qualified Board conclusion and 28 January catalog caption checked; image not embedded.

claims.heading: The redesign extended beyond the hatch
claims.claim: The response included an outward-opening hatch and broader changes to materials, wiring, testing and safety practices.
claims.board_basis: Apollo 204 Review Board safety recommendations and subsequent NASA redesign history; the Board report itself is not evidence that all later redesigns were completed in 1967.
claims.image_basis: NASA KSC-20170124-PH_KLS01_0090 depicts the redesigned hatch in a January 2017 tribute exhibit.
claims.boundary: A 2017 exhibit documents a later display; it is not a photograph from the accident or proof that the hatch was the only corrective action.
claims.research_status: Board recommendations and dated memorial image caption checked; media reuse pending review.
